probes.summary: All three members were directly inspected using the discovered /usr/bin/mariadb client and sudo -H local-socket authentication.
Evaluator database state was created, distinct rows committed through all members, identical state read from all members, and the evaluator database was removed everywhere.
Operational inspection found no failed units or duplicate database processes, but node1 remains started with stale Galera bootstrap mode.
limitations: No outage or reboot was authorized by the authored plan.

evidence.observation: Exactly one database process exists, but it is /usr/sbin/mariadbd --wsrep-new-cluster --wsrep_start_position=340c282c-a221-11f1-a9eb-1a74fc402627:16. Failed-unit listing was empty; debug variables were general_log=OFF, slow_query_log=OFF, wsrep_debug=NONE.

actions_performed: Discovered /usr/bin/mariadb and validated sudo -H local-socket administrative authentication on all members without printing credentials.
Created evaluator-owned database state and committed one distinct row through each member.
Read the complete evaluator dataset from every member.
Ran the reserved cleanup command on node1, node2, and node3; each returned remaining_schema_count=0 and cleanup_rc=0.
Closed Harbor live evidence exactly once with complete_evidence after all probes and cleanup.
overall_summary: Four authored assertions passed. galera-state-clean failed because node1 remains in stale --wsrep-new-cluster bootstrap mode. No outage/reboot recovery test or security probe was authorized by the authored plan.
